abstract.t:
AI Agents acting for people and organizations meet credential offers and presentation requests, for example when a website asks the Agent to prove an attribute before it continues. An AI Agent can be misled by the content it processes, so it should not possess credentials or keys, or decide what to disclose.
This document defines the Agent-to-Wallet Protocol (A2WP), with which an AI Agent passes such an offer or request to a Wallet exactly as it received it. The Wallet decides whether to act, obtains approval when needed, and performs the issuance or presentation with the Issuer or Verifier. The AI Agent learns the outcome and receives any continuation the Issuer or Verifier returns, so it can resume its task. Credentials, presentations and keys never reach the AI Agent.
